# Bari-CPAP

Legacy Python analysis for a University of Utah bariatric surgery cohort examining CPAP use, serum bicarbonate trajectories, and suspected obesity hypoventilation syndrome.

## Scholarly Record
- Primary citable record: "Changes in Bicarbonate in Patients at Risk for Obesity Hypoventilation Undergoing Bariatric Surgery."
- Abstract venue: American Thoracic Society 2022 International Conference; American Journal of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine 2022;205(Supplement_1):A4996.
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1164/ajrccm-conference.2022.205.1_MeetingAbstracts.A4996
- Public talk page: https://reblocke.github.io/talks/2022-HCO3-BARIATRIC
- Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/Bari-CPAP

## Repository Purpose
- Preserves legacy Python code used for the bariatric surgery / suspected OHS bicarbonate analysis.
- Restores the historical HCO3 workbook loader and patient-record model expected by `DataAnalysis.py`.
- Makes the workflow runnable on local compatible workbooks without exposing restricted clinical data.

## Run Path
```bash
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
python DataAnalysis.py --input-dir data/private --output-dir outputs/legacy-python
```

Expected local-only inputs:
- `data/private/BARI_SLEEP_CPAP_COMPLIANCE_092619.xlsx`
- `data/private/Bari HCO3 10-30-21-working.xlsx`

Generated outputs:
- `outputs/legacy-python/DescriptiveStats.txt`
- `outputs/legacy-python/*.xlsx`
- `outputs/legacy-python/*.png`
- `outputs/legacy-python/dist figs/*.png`

## Data Restrictions
- The source workbooks are restricted patient-level clinical data and must not be committed.
- Generated row-level outputs such as `full_output.xlsx` and `output.xlsx` are local-only.
- Historical aggregate outputs are archived at https://github.com/reblocke/Bari-CPAP/releases/tag/legacy-ats2022-aggregate-outputs-2026-06-04.

## Machine-Readable Files
- `README.md` gives human-facing context and run instructions.
- `CITATION.cff` contains structured software and abstract citation metadata.
- `data_dictionary.md` and `data_dictionary.csv` document expected workbook variables, derived fields, and outputs.
- `AGENTS.md` gives repository-specific instructions for future coding agents.

## Agent Cautions
- Do not restore `.idea/`, generated root output files, or `dist figs/` to the default branch.
- Do not copy publisher abstract text or private manuscript drafts into Markdown.
- Preserve legacy analysis logic unless a separate scientific refactor is requested.
- Keep output paths under ignored output folders.
